# FreeCAD

> FreeCAD is a free, open-source 3D parametric CAD modeler for product design, mechanical engineering, and 3D printing workflows.

FreeCAD provides comprehensive documentation through its main website and community wiki, covering everything from beginner tutorials to advanced developer APIs. The project is supported by the FreeCAD Project Association (FPA) and welcomes community contributions across multiple platforms including Windows, Mac, and Linux.

## Key Topics

- 3D parametric modeling
- CAD design
- Open-source software
- Workbenches
- BIM (Building Information Modeling)
- STEP/IGES/STL file formats
- Product design
- Mechanical engineering
- 3D printing
- Python scripting
- API development
- Community contributions
- Cross-platform (Windows, Mac, Linux)
- NURBS geometry
- Parametric design

- [FreeCAD Homepage](https://www.freecad.org): FreeCAD main site for open-source 3D modeling and CAD design

- [Getting Started Guide](https://wiki.freecad.org/Getting_started): FreeCAD getting started guide for new users
- [Tutorials](https://wiki.freecad.org/Tutorials): FreeCAD tutorials and how-to guides
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://wiki.freecad.org/Frequently_asked_questions): FreeCAD frequently asked questions and common issues
